title: Orbit of a block countdown
statement: Let $P,Q:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}^*$, let $K\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $s_0$ be a bit string. Let $g$ be the block-loop step determined by update and next functions $\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt}:\{0,1\}^*\times\{0,1\}^*\to\{0,1\}^*$, and write $\langle u,v\rangle$ for the self-delimiting pair encoding. Suppose $s_0=\langle P(0),\langle 1^K,Q(0)\rangle\rangle$, every $P(i)$ is nonempty for $i\le K$, and for every $i<K$, $\mathrm{upd}(P(i),Q(i))=P(i+1)$ and $\mathrm{nxt}(P(i),Q(i))=Q(i+1)$. Then for each $i\le K$, the $i$-th iterate of $g$ at $s_0$ is $\langle P(i),\langle 1^{K-i},Q(i)\rangle\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is the block-loop step determined by $\mathrm{upd},\mathrm{nxt}$
$P,Q$ are functions from natural numbers to bit strings
